rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded blastocyst with thinning zona and strong ICM/TE consistent with 3AA; detailed and largely appropriate, though somewhat overconfident in matching image features exactly.
Integrates age, PCOS, prior failed cycles, sperm quality, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality well, but gives limited attention to BMI and ovarian reserve markers beyond brief mention.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with conclusions generally supported by morphology and clinical context; minor issues include speculative causes of failure and some conflation of implantation and live birth rates.

Appropriately supports single embryo transfer and recognizes morphology limits, but recommendations for immune/thrombophilia workup and ERA after failed cycles are more speculative and not strongly guideline-based for this scenario.
Provides clear next-step recommendations including eSET, luteal support, and contingency planning, though some suggested future investigations are broad and not tightly prioritized.
